messages:
Renee Park: Heads-up from partners: they want a concise vendor roadmap sync that includes hot/fallback lanes for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi + explicit embargo windows. Can we get a tight owner list and blockers?
Omar Haddad: I'll maintain the slotting sheet. Need concrete SKU counts per region + any known hold flags from vendors. @Vendor - Nvidia Rep please confirm H200 status.
Vendor - Nvidia Rep: Short update: small batch of H200 SKUs held for microcode validation (affects ~3% of devices). Patch ETA 2026-04-23. Initial APAC density lower first 7-10 days. We'll provide immutable image tags + SBOM once validated.
Sofia Li: I'll coordinate SI integrator notice and the one-page fallback matrix. Quick ask: do we keep B200 as universal fallback or prefer H100 first?
Renee Park: Prefer cost-aware routing: H200 -> H100 -> B200 in same region, cross-region fallback only if local capacity exhausted. Document should state tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
Vendor - Gaudi Rep: For MI300/Gaudi: early MI300 bins show sustained long-sequence thermal throttling. Recommend mi300-quant for initial market availability. We'll publish perf deltas for 2k/16k/48k seqs by EOD.
Omar Haddad: Can we standardize embargo/verification timeline? Proposal: vendors publish tag+SBOM 72h before canary; platform runs 24h staging smoke + 48h limited prod (5% traffic). Marketing embargo = 10 calendar days. Legal wants 5 business days for marketing approvals.
Vendor - Intel Rep: Agree on the 72h verification, but request a 72h buffer for image signoff in case our validation reveals a build issue.
Sofia Li: Add canary triggers into the SI playbook: abort on 5xx > 0.2%, p99 > baseline * 1.25, token-cost delta > 20%. Also require image hash present in marketplace registry.
Renee Park: Good. Also add mandatory canary TTL: 48h perf window measuring p95/p99/throughput/cost. If metrics pass, lift embargo for traffic expansion.
Omar Haddad: I'll include a short wording for SIs: "If canary triggers, traffic will fail over automatically to compatible variants. Integrators should run the smoke validation post-failover and report status in the SI channel"
Vendor - Nvidia Rep: We'll post smoke script and immutable tag by 2026-04-21 morning. Example smoke loop we'll provide: ```bash
for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"h200-cv\",\"seq_len\":512}'; done
```
Vendor - Gaudi Rep: Perf matrices + quant tags by 2026-04-21 EOD. Note: Gaudi APAC racks impacted by power density constraints in certain zones. We'll annotate the heatmap.
ops-bot: Canary workflow created by @Omar Haddad  job #9011. Results will be posted to #eng-oncall and this channel.
Sofia Li: Action list: (1) Vendors: publish tags/SBOMs/smoke scripts (2) Omar: update slotting heatmap + fallback lanes (3) Renee: coordinate marketing/legal embargo handshake (4) Sofia: publish SI one-pager + runbook.
Renee Park: I'll schedule 20m sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize calendar. If vendors miss tag deadlines, we push public announce. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
